title: A Father's Promise
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji gripped that power, Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang in his mind: 'What he gave you is not just power—there is also a sealed memory. But think carefully about whether to unseal it or not.'

text.content: As the darkness receded like the tide, Chen Ji found himself standing in a void. No sky, no earth—only a patch of ground beneath his feet, as if torn from the vast cosmos by some force. His father's phantom floated not far away, that face matching his deepest memories now filled with vicissitudes and remorse. Chen Ji's knuckles whitened as he clenched his fists—he had waited for this moment far too long.

dialogue.content: [His voice trembled slightly, yet he forcibly suppressed it] All these years, I've thought countless times... what you would say to me if you were still here. Would you scold me for being useless, or boast about your divine powers? But I never imagined it would be like this—at the end of karma and reincarnation, you tell me you regret it?

[Chen Tianming's phantom drifted closer, his voice like it had traveled through endless years] Regret? These two words are too light. What I owe you is twenty years of companionship, your mother dying while I was in seclusion, Little Nian being taken while I was fleeing... I am a failed father, Chen Ji. I don't even deserve to ask for your forgiveness.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a dull ache in his chest. It was the grievance he had suppressed for years finally finding an outlet. He remembered the night his mother died of illness, kneeling alone in the mourning hall with no adult to preside over the arrangements. He remembered Chen Nian's heart-wrenching cries as black-clad figures took her away, while he could only watch helplessly. He remembered countless nights being ridiculed as waste, with no one to comfort him.

dialogue.content: [Suddenly looked up, eyes glistening with tears yet refusing to let them fall] Do you know how I survived? At Tianqing Sect, I was a servant anyone could step on. No one knew I was Chen Tianming's son, because that would bring shame upon you. [His voice suddenly rose] You had your glory, but what about me?

[Chen Tianming's form trembled violently, the phantom's glow dimming] I know. I know it all. Every time the Tianji Record activated, I could see your situation—but I couldn't intervene, couldn't even warn you. [His voice choked] You ask why I didn't come back? Because if I returned, it would expose your identity, would attract more people to target you... I could only gamble that you would survive in this way.

text.content: Chen Ji's body went rigid. He had never considered this possibility—that his father's absence was not abandonment, but another form of protection. But the cost of such protection was too great. So great that he nearly died in some corner of Tianqing Sect, so great that he was separated from his sister for years.

dialogue.content: [Took a deep breath,勉强平复情绪] Then what about Little Nian? You always said she would return... How is she really doing at the Holy Sect? [His voice suddenly lowered] I cannot see her face in my foresight. Every scene with her is blurred... Do you know why?

[Chen Tianming's gaze shifted复杂] Because she is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Her existence itself is an interference to the Tianji Record—the more blood-related she is to you, the harder it is for the Tianji Record to capture their fate trajectory. [Paused] But this also means, as long as you find her, you can break this interference... She is the key to reversing your fate.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key—this unfamiliar term yet made his heart ache inexplicably. He remembered Chen Nian's last smile before she disappeared, that little girl who always followed behind him calling 'big brother,' now became the key piece to turn the tide. But he did not want his sister to become anyone's piece, not even if that entity was Heaven itself.

dialogue.content: [Chen Tianming's form began fading increasingly] Time is running out. This wisp of remnant consciousness I left in the cracks of karma is about to dissipate. [Gazing at Chen Ji] So before the end, I want to ask you one thing—do you want to inherit the complete power of the Tianji Record and become the new Prophet? Or... do you want to walk a completely different path?

choice.prompt: Father's question was like a key, Chen Ji had to make a choice—to inherit the Prophet's mission, or forge his own path.

choices.description: Accept the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record, become the new Prophet, and continue father's mission
choices.visible_cost: Will bear the fate and burden of all previous Prophets
choices.visible_reward: Gain the complete power of the Tianji Record and father's lifetime of insights
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Will may detect this and act prematurely

dialogue.content: [A flicker of gratification appeared in Chen Tianming's eyes] Good. Your willingness to bear this responsibility is the greatest forgiveness you can give me. [Extended his ethereal hand] Grip it and accept the inheritance.

choices.description: Refuse to become a Prophet, but will protect everything father cherished, including Little Nian
choices.visible_cost: May lose part of the Tianji Record's abilities
choices.visible_reward: Break free from the fetters of fate,争取小念的自由 for Little Nian
choices.risk_hint: Heaven may view you as a variable and intensify its elimination efforts

dialogue.content: [Chen Tianming's smile carried bitterness and relief] I knew you would choose this. [Sighed softly] You were never one to follow the script... This trait resembles me, yet you're braver.

choices.description: Both accept the inheritance and vow to surpass,弥补父亲当年的遗憾
choices.visible_cost: The process will be unimaginably arduous
choices.visible_reward: Complete Tianji Record inheritance + possibility of forging a completely new path
choices.risk_hint: Success or failure will determine the final ownership of fate

dialogue.content: [Chen Tianming's phantom trembled violently, eyes bursting with unprecedented light] Good! Good! Good! With such ambition, you are worthy of being my son, Chen Tianming! [Voice choked] I dared not think such things when I was young, yet you dare... This is truly rising above the master.

text.content: Chen Ji felt the warm energy in his palm, resonating with the remnant Tianji Record的气息 in his body. That was the crystallization of his father's lifetime of cultivation, the accumulation of countless days and nights of solitary resistance against fate. Light spilled from between his fingers, illuminating this silent void.

dialogue.content: [Chen Tianming's phantom had faded to near transparency] Whatever choice you make, I will support you. This time, I will not decide for you. [His voice grew lighter] Little Nian is entrusted to you... Also, find that existence that wants to control everything, and ask it on behalf of me... on behalf of all those it has toyed with—a question.
[Chen Ji gripped the orb of light tightly] What question?

[The phantom was now only a faint outline, yet the words were exceptionally clear] Ask it—whether a chess piece also has the right to make a comeback. [The final voice like a sigh] I believe you will make better choices than I did... Because you are my son.

text.content: The moment the words fell, Chen Tianming's form scattered completely, like morning mist dispersed by sunlight. But the orb of light in Chen Ji's palm grew increasingly brilliant, the warm energy flowing through his meridians, as if father's hand was gently stroking his head.

Chen Ji stood rooted in place, not moving for a long time. He raised his head, his gaze penetrating the void, as if he could see the last look his father gave him before dissipating—that gaze held no regret, only expectation. Suddenly, he spoke softly, his voice echoing in the empty void: 'Father, I will. I will bring Little Nian home, and then go ask that so-called Heaven—why does it think we can only be chess pieces.'

The light condensed in his palm, slowly sinking into the Tianji Record Fragment. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented fullness surge through his body—the Tianji Record Fragment had finally completed its most crucial core part, extending the foresight time limit from three hours to a full day and night. He took a deep breath, and when he opened his eyes, he found himself back in the stone cave at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Su Qingyao stood guard at the cave entrance, looking at him with a complex expression.

dialogue.content: [Su Qingyao walked over quickly, eyes flashing with surprise] You... your aura has changed. What happened? [Her gaze fell on the faintly glowing Tianji Record in his arms] That thing... is complete?
